title: Financial Times News Scraper input

sections.title: FT RSS sections
sections.description: Financial Times public RSS sections to scrape (headlines, standfirsts, images, publish times). Select one or more. Defaults to International home + Markets. Returns public feed metadata — not full paywalled article body text.

searchKeywords.title: Keyword filter
searchKeywords.description: Optional case-insensitive keywords. Keep only articles whose headline, standfirst, or keywords contain at least one term (e.g. ['Fed','oil']). Leave empty to keep all items from selected sections.

searchQuery.title: Keyword search (Bing News site:ft.com)
searchQuery.description: Optional topic search via Bing News RSS filtered to ft.com. Use this instead of FT site search (robots.txt disallows /search). Returns headline + snippet + URL. Leave empty to skip.

articleUrls.title: Article URLs
articleUrls.description: Optional list of ft.com /content/{uuid} URLs. Each URL is enriched from public Open Graph / meta tags only when HTML is reachable. Does not bypass the FT paywall or return subscription-only full text. Use only permitted direct/public or licensed API access verified against the actual build. Stop on access denial or rate limits; see the source access gate.

sinceHours.title: Only articles newer than (hours)
sinceHours.description: Optional recency window. If set to e.g. 24, only articles with publishedAt within the last 24 hours are kept. Use 0 (default) for all currently returned feed/search items.

maxItems.title: Max articles
maxItems.description: Hard cap on articles scraped and billed across all sources. Each accepted article is one billable article-found event. Defaults to 50. Set lower for cheap test runs.

proxyConfiguration.title: Restricted access control
proxyConfiguration.description: VibeLeads restriction: enablement is unsupported. Verify a documented disabled/direct/public mode and actual build behavior before execution; otherwise decline this route. See the source access gate.

x-vibeleads-execution-review: required; schema inspection is not execution permission
